amendments.because: The CI logs have no per-test times, so the data cannot be refreshed until a nightly run records them
amendments.done_when: The test duration data is refreshed from current Linux CI timings and the six groups of a full pull request run finish within a few minutes of each other

done_when: The nightly full run records each test's duration and uploads it as a timing artifact, so the next refresh of the duration data can balance the six pull request groups
why: Forge's six pull request test groups are uneven (24.5 to 38.1 minutes in one run) because the duration data that splits them is stale; repo.py's duration-based split already exists
